scope: Training-only frozen diagnostic with canonical source paths; exact same384 audio hashes and canonical variant0 IDs as the pre-scoring v1 plan. No detector scores informed correction.
source_activity_diagnostic: Training source PCM only;10ms nonoverlapping RMS frames, active when RMS>=max(peak_frame_RMS*.01,1). Report warm sampling endpoints within first..last active source-frame bounds plus.32s tail. This describes source activity, not complete embedding receptive-field coverage or phonetic ground truth.
readout: Report full training score distribution and group/phrase attribution without choosing a detector threshold or accepting a model. Select no new training/evaluation sources from scores.
source_path_correction: One canonical path per already frozen audio hash. Bind its four exact source/variant job IDs, preserving the selected original variant0 ID; equivalent same-role spelling paths are not additional independent recordings.
